issues.where: cell H, Andes along the terminator
issues.what: grazing light turns the ridges into an extruded plastic height map
issues.fix: cut normal and displacement strength so the mountains read at orbital scale

issues.where: top-left crop, Rockies and Sierra Madre
issues.what: the ranges are embossed and glossy, more plastic than the day-side terrain
issues.fix: use one milder relief scale on both frames so ridges do not catch a plastic highlight

issues.where: cell C, aurora on the night limb
issues.what: the curtain is a sheet of evenly spaced vertical rays
issues.fix: break the ray spacing and soften the fade so it does not read as a stripe texture

issues.where: middle limb crop, sunlit cloud edge
issues.what: clouds smear into streaks that follow the curve
issues.fix: keep cloud detail from stretching at grazing angles

issues.where: cells G and E, northern terrain and night lights
issues.what: softer than the matching crops in image-02, and the city lights bloom into specks
issues.fix: restore the sharpness of the first frame and keep night lights as small points

issues.where: C and I, upper-right aurora above the night-side limb
issues.what: The green curtain breaks into a row of similar upright spikes, while a separate smooth green streak follows the surface below. The two edges read as stacked effects rather than one volume.
issues.fix: Vary the heights, spacing and density of the curtains, and fade their bases into the same atmospheric volume instead of drawing a separate green surface streak.

issues.where: D, F and H, long middle- and foreground cloud shadows across the sea
issues.what: Several shadows become narrow, nearly uniform dark shafts with smeared tips. The fine water texture that remains visible alongside them gets nearly erased inside the shafts.
issues.fix: Render the shadows from the cloud volumes with varied opacity and penumbra, modulating the ocean lighting without losing surface texture beneath them.

issues.where: B and D, illuminated left limb
issues.what: A thin white outline remains distinct inside the broad cyan halo, tracing the globe like a second edge.
issues.fix: Reduce the narrow white peak and blend it continuously into the atmospheric falloff.

issues.where: K and P, Pacific cloud systems west of North and Central America
issues.what: Several cloud bands curl into similarly smooth, tightly pinched spirals. The bright spiral in P has especially regular, comb-like filaments around its center.
issues.fix: Break up the regular filaments with varied gaps, turbulence and uneven cloud density, while preserving the large storm shapes.

issues.where: A and H, northern Andes and western edge of South America
issues.what: The compressed band of bright ridges makes the mountains look embossed relative to the softer surrounding terrain.
issues.fix: Lower the relief and highlight contrast at globe scale and add irregular foothill and terrain transitions.

issues.where: T and W, open star field below and to the sides of the globe
issues.what: Some brighter stars resolve into similarly sized soft disks rather than distinct point-like cores.
issues.fix: Keep sharper subpixel cores and vary bloom with brightness, reserving visible halos for the brightest stars.
